Arrange an FMEA Risk Register for Display

Source: R/fmea.R
fmea_register_view.Rd

Orders a risk register produced by r4subrisk::create_risk_register() by its Risk Priority Number (RPN) so the highest-priority risks appear first, and keeps a fixed set of display columns. This is a pure, non-reactive helper behind the dashboard's FMEA tab.

Usage

fmea_register_view(
  register,
  columns = c("risk_id", "description", "category", "probability", "impact",
    "detectability", "rpn", "risk_level"),
  max_rows = 100L
)

Arguments

register

A risk register data.frame, as returned by r4subrisk::create_risk_register(). Must contain an rpn column.

columns

Character vector of columns to keep, in display order. Columns that are not present in register are dropped silently. Defaults to the FMEA breakdown (probability, impact, detectability) alongside the rpn and risk_level.

max_rows

Maximum number of rows to return. Default 100.

Value

A data.frame with the selected columns, ordered by descending rpn (ties keep their original order) and truncated to max_rows rows. Row names are reset.

Details

It performs no scoring of its own: the rpn, probability, impact, detectability, and risk_level values are exactly those computed by 'r4subrisk'. The helper only reorders rows and selects columns, so it is easy to unit test without launching the app.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("r4subrisk", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ev <- suppressMessages(generate_demo_evidence(40, seed = 1))
  risks <- suppressMessages(r4subrisk::evidence_to_risks(ev))
  reg <- suppressMessages(r4subrisk::create_risk_register(risks))
  head(fmea_register_view(reg))
}
